why: "At the start of any phase" and the battle-shock effects apply in both players' turns: either. The FAQ line does not change this.

The text matches GW's Faction Pack (Chaos Daemons 1.2, Blood Legion page, after MURDERCALL) and Wahapedia word for word. "At the end of a phase in which … destroyed an enemy unit" can trigger at the end of any phase, because units are destroyed in every phase (Daemonic Terror mortal wounds in Command, Desperate Escape in Movement, shooting, fighting). All five phases is right.
Your unit can destroy an enemy unit in either player's turn (fights and Overwatch in the opponent's turn), and the control check is "at the end of a phase": either.
"a LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE unit from your army" → all [Faction: Legiones Daemonica, Khorne]. This is the same convention as Murdercall's needs, and its Applies to list is the list's Khorne daemons.

The only change is the guard loop. A unit's own guard is now skipped unless the guard has selfWhen or selfAlways (before, it was always skipped, src !== u), and the line uses selfWhen on its own sheet. Only Prince of Darkness has either key (the guard list in data.js: Shroudpsalm, Omnissiah's Blessing, Necromechanic, Emanatus Forcefield, Daughters of the Abyss have neither), so every other list behaves exactly as before. The rendered Daemon Prince sheet shows 'Own aura: Stealth: the benefit of cover against ranged attacks (Prince of Darkness)', and the other units show 'Within 6" of the Daemon Prince of Chaos: …'. Dedupe still compares the full line. No other list's snapshot changed.

rulesOf, detRows and onceRules now go through detRules(d) (rule, then moreRules), each row with src d.name. The Detachments row still links the detachment name to its first rule. The rendered Overview lists Murdercall then Blood Tainted ('Blood Legion · Any phase') after the army rules. Every other list's Overview is unchanged (snapshots identical apart from the list picker showing the new lists).
